title: Forms & Controlled Components
description:
## Forms & Controlled Components

In React, form elements like `<input>`, `<textarea>`, and `<select>` can be **controlled** — their value is driven by React state.

### Pattern
```jsx
const [name, setName] = useState('');
<input value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} />
```

### Your Task
Build a registration form:
1. A text input for **name** with id `"name-input"`
2. An **email** input with id `"email-input"`
3. A `<select>` for **role** with id `"role-select"` and options: `"student"`, `"developer"`, `"designer"`
4. A **submit button** with id `"submit-btn"`
5. All inputs must be **controlled** (value + onChange)
6. On submit, **prevent page reload** and show a `<div id="summary">` displaying: **"Name: [name], Email: [email], Role: [role]"**
7. The summary should only appear after submission
